pick.headline: Body of kidnapped former Italian premier Aldo Moro found in Rome

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, Vol. III No. 90, 9 May 1978
evidence.snippet: …of distrust, an atmosphere of arson, denunciations, assassinations and so forth--is to the benefit of the rightists in fact. What emerges is a definite union of the rightists and leftists. For example, the kidnaping of Moro, the former Italian prime minister, who has kidnaped him? These Red Brigades--who are they? When they began to unravel this affair--I mean the Italian authorities, the democratic forces and the Italian Comminist Party--…
